decision: Reject uniform progressive installation of the V417 factorized attention and reject global source-neuron support. Both violate the current active projection envelope before a complete English host exists. A materially new conditional-support representation is required.

bounded_dynamic_local_candidate.active_support_rule: Exactly five source attention heads and exactly 432 nonlinear units active per token; no top-k or width sweep.
bounded_dynamic_local_candidate.storage_rule: Selections may reference shared immutable dictionaries, but the complete stored candidate must remain below the source teacher and below the locked deployed-footprint gate. Duplicated per-expert copies are prohibited.
bounded_dynamic_local_candidate.execution_rule: Selection must physically precede projection; dense execution followed by masking is prohibited.

oracle_boundary: The oracle may use target residuals only to measure whether the fixed 5-head/432-unit active support can represent held-out layer-1 behavior. It may not train or promote a router, write a component, access final material, or support a model claim. A miss closes this dynamic-local support budget. A pass authorizes a train-only routing-realization protocol under a separate cost and leakage review.
claim_boundary: No-model architecture and arithmetic review only; no conditional-support quality, router, storage, runtime, autonomous, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
